content.text:
JPMorgan Says Micron's Rally May Not Be Over: The article summarizes Sur’s expectation of a Q4 beat and November-quarter outlook increase, his interpretation of price moderation, estimated SCA coverage above 35% with contracted volumes potentially above 50%, expected HBM supply insufficiency through 2028, and a reported capital-return plan after the Dec. 9 CHIPS-agreement anniversary. The estimates and interpretations are attributed to the analyst; the capital-return statement is article reporting, not a new company filing. (time=2026-09-29 13:21 (timezone UNKNOWN); cutoff=UNKNOWN).
JPMorgan Sees Micron Positioned for Beat-and-Raise Ahead of Q4 Results: The article independently reports JPMorgan’s constructive pre-report expectations and notes that consensus estimates were already above Micron’s then-published Q4 guidance. It supplies a second contemporaneous account of the expectations setting; it does not independently verify JPMorgan’s internal SCA estimates. (time=2026-09-29T12:45:00-04:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

content.text: Citi Raises Micron Stock (MU) Price Target Ahead of Q4 Earnings. Here’s Why: The article reports Citi analyst Atif Malik expected AI demand to keep DRAM and NAND supply tight, while forecasting slower memory-price growth over the next four quarters and a peak around Q2 2027. It also reports that Malik raised near-term estimates based on stronger blended DRAM pricing on output not locked into long-term agreements.
